{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Total orders per segment (including refunded)
total_per_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment').size()
print("Total orders per segment:")
print(total_per_segment)

# Completed orders per segment
completed_per_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment').size()
print("Completed orders per segment:")
print(completed_per_segment)

# Conversion rate = completed / total
table = (completed_per_segment / total_per_segment) * 100
print("Conversion rate by segment (\%):")
print(table)"}}
